scope: Whole OnRegion constructor, Enable and Update and PlayAnimation placement with full arena and ordered boundary traces. Actual native matrix product is used in every Update case; actual tolerant point predicate is used in mode 1 and separately compared in mode 4. Barn, camera, metadata casts, transform/OBB virtuals, Clump enabling and Event.Start remain explicit external services. Covers flags, pair and distinct counts, SIMD reduction, signed thresholds, origin/NaN skip, remote avatar activation, private position W and callback rereads. Shared scene EventBarn/Model/viewport and rail movement are not accepted by this comparison.
